source_book: The Brand Relationship Spectrum — Aaker & Joachimsthaler (2000)

test_cases.prompt: The parent brand's image would clash with this new product — we need a totally separate brand.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate aaker-relation-house-of-brands; justify separation to avoid association contamination.

test_cases.prompt: This different retail channel needs its own brand, like our other house-of-brands setup.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate aaker-relation-house-of-brands; assign a separate brand per channel to avoid conflict.

test_cases.prompt: We want a separate brand for each niche like P&G does with detergents.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate aaker-relation-house-of-brands; explain niche-positioning via independent brands.

test_cases.prompt: Brand everything under our master like Virgin does.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate aaker-relation-house-of-brands; activate aaker-relation-branded-house (opposite end).
test_cases.notes: Sibling-confusion bait: branded house, not house of brands.

test_cases.prompt: Should this new offering be a subbrand or a new brand?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate aaker-relation-house-of-brands; activate aaker-relation-select-separation (decision).
test_cases.notes: Sibling-confusion bait: decision matrix, not position mechanics.

test_cases.prompt: We want a Lexus-style launch with no visible Toyota link but customers will find out.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate aaker-relation-house-of-brands (shadow endorser is part of this position); note the hybrid credibility-without-contamination logic.
test_cases.notes: Boundary: shadow endorser sits at the top of the spectrum, within house-of-brands logic.

notes: ≥3 should_trigger + 2 should_not_trigger (sibling baits: aaker-relation-branded-house, aaker-relation-select-separation) + 1 edge.
